threshold.value: For Party A, zero if a Collateral Event has occurred and has been continuing (i) for at least 30 Local Business Days if attributable to Moody's, (ii) for at least 10 Local Business Days if attributable to S&P, or (iii) since execution; otherwise, infinity. For Party B, infinity.
threshold.evidence_quote: “Threshold” means, with respect to Party A and any Valuation Date, zero if a Collateral Event has occurred and has been continuing (i) for at least 30 Local Business Days if such Collateral Event is attributable to credit ratings of Moody’s, (ii) for at least 10 Local Business Days if such Collateral Event is attributable to credit ratings of S&P or (iii) since this Annex was executed; otherwise, infinity.

minimum_transfer_amount.value: USD 100,000 for Party A and Party B; provided that if the aggregate Class Certificate Balance of the Certificates rated by S&P ceases to be more than USD 50,000,000, it shall be USD 50,000.
minimum_transfer_amount.evidence_quote: “Minimum Transfer Amount” means USD 100,000 with respect to Party A and Party B; provided, however, that if the aggregate Class Certificate Balance of the Certificates rated by S&P ceases to be more than USD 50,000,000, the “Minimum Transfer Amount” shall be USD 50,000.

rounding.value: Delivery Amount rounded up to the nearest integral multiple of USD 10,000; Return Amount rounded down to the nearest integral multiple of USD 1,000.
rounding.evidence_quote: The Delivery Amount will be rounded up to the nearest integral multiple of USD 10,000. The Return Amount will be rounded down to the nearest integral multiple of USD 1,000.

valuation_percentage.value: The applicable S&P Approved Ratings Valuation Percentage, S&P Required Ratings Valuation Percentage, Moody’s First Trigger Valuation Percentage or Moody’s Second Trigger Valuation Percentage for such Eligible Collateral or Posted Collateral, respectively, as set forth in Paragraph 13(b)(ii).
valuation_percentage.evidence_quote: “Valuation Percentage” shall mean, for purposes of determining the S&P Approved Ratings Value, the S&P Required Ratings Value, the Moody’s First Trigger Value or the Moody’s Second Trigger Value with respect to any Eligible Collateral or Posted Collateral, the applicable S&P Approved Ratings Valuation Percentage, S&P Required Ratings Valuation Percentage, Moody’s First Trigger Valuation Percentage or Moody’s Second Trigger Valuation Percentage for such Eligible Collateral or Posted Collateral, respectively, in each case as set forth in Paragraph 13(b)(ii).
